verdict.rationale: Northwest Registered Agent is a registered-agent and business-formation service, not an AI agent or tool-consuming assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools falls outside this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
